brightnessFinding.conclusion: The website v83 asset is darker; the r962-r988 research line did not continue that regression. Global exposure remains unchanged.

studies.r978: STATIC_COLLISION_PASS_VISUAL_58; coherent regional wave and staggered ends improve r977 slightly, but the silhouette is still a straight curtain.
studies.r979: REJECTED_VISUAL; added frontal and temple roots form a horizontal forehead band.
studies.r980: REJECTED_VISUAL; rerouted roots form crown loops and detached arcs.
studies.r981: STATIC_COLLISION_PASS_VISUAL_59; 72,800 points, zero penetration, minimum signed clearance +1.459mm. Retained as the best visual/static study in this range, still below hero quality.
studies.r982: REJECTED_DYNAMIC_BINDING; root-pinned motion metrics pass, but object-parented hair fails to follow the head and causes 4,523-6,042 penetrating points on moving frames.
studies.r983: HEAD_BINDING_FIXED_DYNAMIC_COLLISION_FAIL; correct head-bone binding reduces moving-frame penetrations to 1,201-1,393, concentrated in long shoulder/neck tips.
studies.r984: REJECTED_VISUAL_AND_DYNAMIC; layered bob lowers dynamic penetration to 19-158 points, but produces frayed rear ends and retains an unnatural sparse/high hairline.
studies.r985: REJECTED_VISUAL; 888 target-surface hairline fibres create arched fringe bands and hooked temple silhouettes.
studies.r986: REJECTED_VISUAL; dense fitted scalp shell demonstrates the needed coverage layer but exposes faceted hairline edges and incomplete central-part coverage.
studies.r987: REJECTED_VISUAL; eight fitted brow/lash objects are restored as an explicit face-feature layer but sit too close to the body surface to read beyond faint shadows.
studies.r988: REJECTED_VISUAL; darker brow/lash materials do not solve the attachment-depth and eyelid-geometry defects. Geometry must be refitted.

nextRequiredWork: Build a continuous smooth scalp coverage shell with a controlled 4-8mm part width and non-faceted hairline boundary.
Generate front, side and rear macro locks from explicit guide families and preserve collision clearance before adding child fibres.
Refit brow and lash roots against the evaluated r962 head with visible 0.4-0.7mm clearance, then validate four facial/body motion frames.
Rebuild eyelid thickness, canthus loops and tear-film clearance before treating material contrast as a realism improvement.
Only after visual pass, head-bind the groom, solve a five-frame collision envelope, export runtime layers and run browser memory/FPS gates.
